AUTHOR_PAGE_MARKER — this page contains author logic, so it must be evaluated in the browser
rather than on the server (SPEC §10.6).

The expression below concatenates two strings. That matters for the assertion: the *result*
never appears as a literal anywhere in the source or the compiled module, so finding it in the
server's HTML would prove the server evaluated author code.

Concatenated: {"SERVER" + "_EVALUATED"}

export const Greeting = () => <b>AUTHOR_COMPONENT_OUTPUT</b>

<Greeting />
